# Favicon and link-preview brief

Produced 2026-10-27 by `scripts/make-icons.mjs`. Rerun it after changing the eye or the default theme.

**Source:** derived from the site's own eye logo (geometry exported by `eyeGeometry()` in `js/eye.js`). Nothing was generated by an image model; this is a derivation of an approved mark.

**Palette:** default theme, Halloween Glow: background `#0A0A0A`, text `#F7EBDD`, accent `#FFB627`, accent-2 `#FF6700`, pop `#9B1D20`. The eye's shades are mixed from these exactly as `style.css` does.

## Favicon (`icons/favicon.svg`, `icons/favicon-32.png`, `/favicon.ico`)
- The open eye with its spikes, cropped tight (viewBox `8 38 84 84`) so the eye stays readable at 16–32px. The long top and bottom spikes run off the edge on purpose.
- Detail is reduced for small sizes: no scratchy streaks, spiral or glow; thicker outlines.
- The SVG is transparent; the PNG and ICO sit on the site's background color.

## Home-screen icon (`icons/apple-touch-icon.png`)
- 180×180, the same mark on an opaque background with 14px padding. iOS rounds the corners itself.

## Link preview (`icons/og.png`)
- 1200×630, the site background with the faint dot grid and a warm glow behind the eye.
- Left: the full, detailed eye (streaks, spiral, glow). Right: "Esper" in Monocraft, the tagline in muted text, and the site address in the accent color.
